metadata.coverage_preamble: Today holds the end of the king, the cat on the chronicle, breakfast with Mistress Ansell, and the Errors reckoning.

yesterday: The king is finished. The last line is ruled. The deposing is still in the book.
There is no fool in it. You set the telling for after Midsummer.
Mistress Ansell asked if it was the lovers. You said no.
Errors at two. The City has been quiet three days.
